caption: A directed net runs through its net control station (NCS). Stations check in one at a time and net control acknowledges each in turn, while everyone else listens. Listen before transmitting and follow net control's direction — in a directed net you transmit only when the NCS directs, unless you are reporting an emergency.
spoken: Net control sits at the center with four stations around it. Numbered arrows show the flow: one, station A checks in; two, net control acknowledges; three, station B checks in; four, net control acknowledges — one at a time — while stations C and D listen. A banner reminds you to listen before transmitting and follow net control's direction.
